<!-- Source page: Polybar -->

[Polybar](https://github.com/polybar/polybar/wiki) is a fast and easy-to-use status bar.

## Getting started

You can copy the example configation from `/nix/store/`<hash>`-polybar-`<version>`/share/doc/polybar`<ins>`/examples`</ins>`/config.ini` to `~/.config/polybar/config.ini` and launch with `polybar -c ~/.config/polybar/config.ini example`

This default configuration requires the icon font 'siji' which can be installed as documented on \[Fonts\]

## Configuration

See the [upstream docs](https://github.com/polybar/polybar/wiki/Configuration) for further configuration options
